The Science
What is HydraFacial MD?

HydraFacial MD is a non-invasive, medical-grade skincare treatment that combines deep cleansing, exfoliation, painless extraction, and intense hydration â all in one 30-minute session. Using patented Vortex-Fusion technology, it delivers skin-nourishing serums deep into your pores for instant, visible results.

Unlike traditional facials, HydraFacial uses a patented 4-in-1 vortex technology that simultaneously cleanses, exfoliates, extracts impurities, and infuses skin with antioxidants, hyaluronic acid, and peptides â leaving you with glass-like, radiant skin.

The Vortex-Fusion technology deeply cleanses pores while pushing active ingredients deep into the skin. It removes makeup residue, blackheads, oil, and debris that regular cleansing can't reach. The serum infusion provides long-lasting hydration and protection, making it the ultimate "glow-up" treatment for all skin types â including sensitive and acne-prone skin.

Patented Vortex Technology
How Does It Work?

Vortex-Fusion Technology

Patented vortex suction deeply cleanses pores while simultaneously infusing active serums â antioxidants, hyaluronic acid, and peptides â deep into the skin. This dual-action approach removes impurities and nourishes in one motion.

LED Light Therapy

Blue and red LED lights target specific concerns â blue light kills acne-causing bacteria and reduces breakouts, while red light stimulates collagen production and reduces inflammation for anti-aging benefits.

The 4-Step HydraFacial Process
1

Cleanse & Exfoliate

Dead skin cells are gently removed, uncovering a fresh, new layer of skin. Vortex technology boosts lymphatic drainage and blood circulation.

2

Gentle Acid Peel

A mild blend of glycolic and salicylic acids loosens dirt and debris from pores. No burning or stinging â just a slight tingle to resurface your skin.

3

Extract & Hydrate

Painless vortex suction extracts blackheads, oil, and impurities. Skin is then nourished with intense moisturizers containing antioxidants and hyaluronic acid.

4

Fuse & Protect

Peptides and antioxidants are infused deep into the skin for hydration and protection. Choose from boosters like DermaBuilder, Britenol, or Growth Factor serums.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Is HydraFacial painful?

Not at all! HydraFacial is one of the most relaxing facial treatments available. Clients describe it as a cool, soothing sensation. There is zero pain, no redness, and no irritation â even for sensitive skin types.

How soon will I see results?

You will see instant results after your very first session â brighter, smoother, more hydrated skin. The glow lasts 5â7 days. With regular monthly sessions, results compound and your skin health improves dramatically over time.

How often should I get HydraFacial?

For optimal skin health, we recommend HydraFacial every 4â6 weeks. For special events like weddings or parties, you can book a session 1â3 days before for that perfect glow. Consistent monthly treatments deliver the best long-term results.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! HydraFacial pairs beautifully with LED therapy, Botox, fillers, chemical peels, and PRP facials. At ISAAC Luxe, our dermatologists often combine HydraFacial with other treatments for a comprehensive skin rejuvenation plan.

Is HydraFacial safe for all skin types?

Absolutely! HydraFacial is safe and gentle for all skin types â including sensitive, oily, dry, combination, and acne-prone skin. The treatment is fully customizable, so serums and boosters are selected specifically for your skin's needs.

What makes ISAAC Luxe HydraFacial special?

At ISAAC Luxe, every HydraFacial is performed under dermatologist supervision. Dr. Geetika's team uses authentic HydraFacial devices with premium serums and custom boosters, ensuring medical-grade results in a luxury setting.
